input.request: Employees book business travel by emailing our travel agency, and managers approve trips informally. Finance only sees travel costs when the invoices arrive a month later, many bookings break the travel policy (for example business-class flights on short routes), and we can't easily locate employees who are travelling if something goes wrong. We want a travel request and booking process with approval, policy checks before booking, and reporting on travel spend.
input.stakeholders: Travelling employees, line managers, finance, travel agency, HR / duty of care
input.existing_systems: Travel agency booking by email, ERP finance system, expense reporting tool
input.constraints: The contract with the current travel agency runs for another 18 months.
